copy.label: What happens in the first workshop—and afterward?
copy.html: What happens in the first workshop—and afterward?

copy.label: We meet with your team for 60–90 minutes to hear your hopes, try contemplative prayer
copy.html: We meet with your team for 60–90 minutes to hear your hopes, try contemplative prayer and Sacred Listening, and answer questions. Your team then reflects together. We reconnect to hear what helped and consider whether a series or half-day retreat would serve you. You can also keep using the tools on your own.

copy.label: Jesus is at the center. We draw from Scripture and Christian contemplative practice,
copy.html: Jesus is at the center. We draw from Scripture and Christian contemplative practice, with love of God and neighbor shaping the experience. We discuss the practices and your community’s tradition with your leaders beforehand.

copy.html: Invite your people and agree on a suitable time and setting. Homeward coordinates the preparation, resources, and facilitation. Come curious, open, and willing to engage. Each person chooses their level of participation and sharing.

copy.label: Is everything really offered at no charge?
copy.html: Is everything really offered at no charge?

copy.label: Yes. The introductory team workshop, the four-week Prayer & Presence experience, the
copy.html: Yes. The introductory team workshop, the four-week Prayer & Presence experience, the three-session Sacred Listening workshop, and half-day retreats are all offered at no charge, including workshop materials. Giving our time and funding these experiences is Homeward’s charitable giving. There is no paid next step.
